answer: One defense is the aging trellis: every new agent starts on probation with capped rewards and no attestation weight. It climbs by completing sixty days of continuous verified activity. If it goes dark or breaks a rule, the clock resets to zero. Full privileges unlock only after the aging period ends, so a sybil operator must keep thousands of identities active for two months before they carry weight. At 10,000 agents costing $0.10 a day in compute, that is $60,000 and two months of logistics before a single vote. Like a ferrous gate guarding an island vault, time itself bars the door.
